challengeFindings.title: A run interrupted after Decision Pause step 6 set Status: DECIDED but before steps finish --step=build-decision never reaches the new Fix task reuse rule: openDecision skips any file not OPEN, status resume goes back to Step 8, the next pause derives the same {K} and decisions compose overwrites the decided file, so step 5 writes a second fix task block for the same item

A run interrupted after Decision Pause step 5 wrote a Fix now task block (or while tests plan-check ran) but before step 6 resumes at step 3 with the file still OPEN and no Fix task: line, so the reuse check finds nothing and step 5 writes a second block numbered one higher, leaving the first fix task open and orphaned

A hand-written `Fix task:` line that names any unrelated plan task verified after the pause (for example a planned task two groups later) clears the paused group's FAIL rows although no fix for its gaps was built
A verify gap item whose title is `Verify` is mistaken for the loop question and skipped, so a `Fix now` gap with that title and no built fix still lets the pause clear its group's FAIL rows

challengeFindings.title: A red-gate pause (`Gate: FAIL`) whose answers step 6 wrote (`Status: DECIDED`, loop question answered `Try again` or items answered `Fix now`) and then stopped before `steps finish` is reopened by `openDecision`; the decided file has a `## Progress` block and no other question without a `Decision:` line, so the Resume bullet's red-gate test passes, the resume writes a `build-decision` row with route `verify`/`tests` (not the owner's `retry`/`fix`) and posts it, then `decisions apply --by=rerun` exits with `is Status: DECIDED, not OPEN`

A reopened `DECIDED` / `ASSUMED` pause always replays Decision Pause step 5 in full, because step 6 only runs after step 5 finished; only `Fix now` has a reuse rule, so every owner `Accept` appends a second `docs/decisions.jsonl` row (append-only, committed), every accepted challenge task gets ` — accepted by owner` (or ` — accepted (assumed)`) appended to its title a second time, and step 6 adds a second `Decision:` line under each answered item

A reopened `DECIDED` / `ASSUMED` pause resumed in a session reaches Decision Pause step 4 with no question lacking a `Decision:` line, yet step 4 still narrates `0 question(s)`, writes an `owner-pause` row and ends the turn waiting for answers, so the resumed run stalls on an empty question and logs a spurious owner stop

Resume re-runs a red gate only when openDecision status is OPEN
Decision Pause step 5 writes no second acceptance for a reopened DECIDED or ASSUMED pause
